finding.expected: Preserve enough immutable observation identity in each result-side binding to distinguish repeated ProductSourcePack observations of the same listing while keeping pairwise relationship and confidence symmetric when input order is reversed. Do not change ProductSourcePack or introduce persistence.
finding.issue: The resolution result preserves listing identity but does not preserve the exact ProductSourcePack observation identity. SourceObservationIdentity contains source_pack_id, platform, source_product_id, and product_url, but omits observed_at or an equivalent immutable observation fingerprint. source_pack_id is stable for repeated observations of the same marketplace listing, so two source packs collected at different times can produce indistinguishable result bindings even though their facts or media may differ. A downstream catalog therefore cannot bind the resolution decision to the exact two observations that were evaluated.
